description: Generate an asset for a video of the iDos Games video studio and get it in the studio's asset format: voxel-character (a voxel hero — CharacterSpec recipe), rig2d-character (a 2D hero — rig recipe), image-actor (any creature or object that acts — picture cut-out), prop (an object in a hand), background (a new scene: the picture goes into a library scene with its anchors and camera shots), music (a loop). Pass the video `package` from plan_video and the plan item's `slot` (cast[0], set, music…): the asset joins package.assets, takes that slot and the answer carries the updated package and its link. Prompts, model settings and the style lock are the studio's own. Costs one generation of the publisher's credits — text for the heroes, image or music for the rest (estimate_media_cost). If it is not ready in about two minutes, call generate_asset again with the same kind and generation_id. Check the hero recipes with validate_asset of @idosgames/mcp before publishing.

base_set.description: background only: the library scene (ref, kind set) whose stage and camera it reuses (default — the first scene of the style).

generation_id.description: Finish an asset whose generation was still running (optional; no new charge).

kind.description: voxel-character | rig2d-character | image-actor | prop | background | music.

package.description: The video package ({ spec, assets }) from plan_video or an earlier generate_asset (optional).

prompt.description: What to make, in English, precise (≤ 400 characters) — e.g. the plan item's generate.prompt.

slot.description: Where the asset goes in the package: cast[<i>], set or music (optional; other slots only add the asset).

style.description: Style family of the video, e.g. voxel-warm or chibi-2d (default voxel-warm). The heroes keep their own style.

tier.description: Quality/price tier of the image/music/text model (optional, see list_ai_tiers).

title.description: Name of the asset in the studio (optional, ≤ 60 characters).

title_id.description: Which game this is for — a label for the report, optional (credits are the publisher's).

name: generate_asset
title: Generate a video asset
